title: Datadog US1 - DST bug in the Datadog Agent
text:
Service: Datadog US1
Maintenance: DST bug in the Datadog Agent
Status: completed
Impact: none
Scheduled for: 2014-11-02T02:00:00.000-05:00
Scheduled until: 2014-11-02T06:00:00.000-05:00
Updates:
- 2014-11-02T06:00:28.213-05:00: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2014-11-02T02:00:23.314-05:00: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2014-11-02T01:00:19.046-05:00: scheduled - Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.
- 2014-10-31T18:46:06.472-04:00: scheduled - We recently discovered an issue that affects Datadog Agents **only on servers with clocks set to Daylight Saving Time (DST)**.

If your servers' clock are set to DST, you should upgrade the Agent to v5.0.5 before DST ends or restart the Agent shortly after DST ends. DST ends this coming Sunday at 2AM. If your servers' clock are set to UTC or to a timezone without DST, you are not affected by this maintenance.

For more details, please read https://github.com/DataDog/dd-agent/wiki/Agent-DST-bug

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

We recently discovered an issue that affects Datadog Agents **only on servers with clocks set to Daylight Saving Time (DST)**.

If your servers' clock are set to DST, you should upgrade the Agent to v5.0.5 before DST ends or restart the Agent shortly after DST ends. DST ends this coming Sunday at 2AM. If your servers' clock are set to UTC or to a timezone without DST, you are not affected by this maintenance.

For more details, please read https://github.com/DataDog/dd-agent/wiki/Agent-DST-bug
